messages:
Clara: heads-up — promo to prod is blocked, deploy-bot failed the canary `artifact-upload` step.
deploy-bot: Promotion aborted: job `canary-integrations` failed (exit=1). Logs: https://ci.redwood/jobs/1757777770 :warning:
Clara: quick grep shows `marshal error: unsupported field type: *proto.ImageBlob` and `multipart finalize: checksum mismatch` during upload handshake.
Samir: repro'd locally with `redwood/builder:edge-2026-04` — works with `redwood/builder:stable-2026-02`. Looks like a proto-gen/schema drift.
Irene: which change touched protobuf generation? @Samir
Samir: PR #1012 updated protobuf-gen and bumped cache schema version. Unit tests passed but integration failed with artifact-store.
Clara: change window in ~90m. Options: 1) pin promo to stable builder image (keep release on schedule), 2) roll back the proto-gen bump (delay), or 3) deploy a temporary upload-shim in artifact-store to accept new messages (coord w/artifact team).
Samir: Shim would be nice but needs artifact-store signoff and a quick patch — probably 45-60m. Pin is lowest friction.
Irene: If we pin we must add a release-note and a follow-up ticket to re-run canary once schema is reconciled. Release team, can you add a blurb? @release
release: noted — will add: "Promo pinned to last-good builder image due to artifact upload schema incompatibility; compatibility verification pending." Tagging `requires-followup`.
ops-bot: Incident created: CI_CANARY_UPLOAD_1757777770. Please acknowledge within 30m to avoid escalation.
Clara: Samir — can you open a tiny MR to pin the runner image in the promo job and kick a rerun? ETA 15m.
Samir: MR posted: https://git.redwood/infra/ci/-/merge_requests/501 — retriggering canary now.
deploy-bot: Manual retrigger requested by Samir — job queued: https://ci.redwood/queue/1757777770 :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Irene: also add a short pipeline tweak: temporary canary auto-retry x2 for multipart uploads to handle transient checksum races.
Samir: will add retry in the MR too (simple backoff).
Clara: if rerun succeeds we promote and schedule a post-release compatibility canary + ticket to reconcile proto-gen. If rerun fails we reconvene and either delay window or push for the artifact-shim path.
Samir: starting a repro matrix (builder edges vs stable cache servers) to capture exact wire diff. Will paste findings here.
Clara: executing pin + retry path for now. Keep updates in-thread. :thumbsup:
